prerequisites: Mastery of trigonometric formulas, functions of a real variable, derivatives, and primitives
Solid foundations in mathematics, including knowledge of trigonometry, derivatives, and integrals

learning_outcomes.text: Review the basics of electrokinetics: electric current and resistance, series and parallel connection of dipoles.
Identify questions within a disciplinary field (Propose analogies, make order of magnitude estimations and grasp their meaning, Manipulate the main mathematical tools useful in physics).
Analyze a question by mobilizing disciplinary concepts (Mobilize fundamental concepts to model, analyze and solve simple physics problems).
Master the main characteristics of ideal dipoles.
Understand wave equations (wave equation, propagation equation).
Deepen and model reflection and refraction phenomena in simple situations (vibrating string).
Address the notion of interference between two waves.
Study standing waves such as those found, for example, in various musical instruments (string instruments, wind instruments...).
Master the basic formalism for modeling simple wave phenomena, particularly mechanical waves: water waves, vibrating strings, sound waves.
Be able to describe and predict interference patterns obtained when two waves (light, sound...) superimpose.

syllabus_topics: Association of ohmic conductors: in series and in parallel
